# ScholarshipTop — extended LLM context
# https://scholarshiptop.com/llms-full.txt
# Companion: https://scholarshiptop.com/llms.txt

## What ScholarshipTop is

ScholarshipTop (https://scholarshiptop.com) is a student-facing scholarship discovery, matching, and guidance platform. It aggregates and structures scholarship-related information: amounts, deadlines, eligibility, requirements, essay prompts where available, and links to official provider sources. It also publishes educational content (resources, essay guides, comparisons) under editorial and verification policies.

ScholarshipTop helps students find, filter, compare, and research scholarships and related programs. It may offer premium subscription tools for enhanced matching and related features (see Subscription below).

ScholarshipTop does **not** award scholarships or financial aid, is **not** the official scholarship provider, and does **not** replace official application processes. Users must verify amounts, deadlines, eligibility, and application details on official provider pages.

## Who it is for

- Students seeking scholarships and financial aid information
- Researchers and educators comparing programs and providers
- International and domestic applicants using public hubs and guides

Account-specific features exist but are not described here; this file covers **public** surfaces only.

## Core public areas

### Scholarships

- Catalog: /scholarships
- Detail pages: /scholarships/{slug} (large database-backed set; use sitemap, do not enumerate inline)
- Category hubs: /scholarships/category/{id}
- Curated hubs: /scholarships/hub/{tab}
- Long-tail and programmatic SEO landing pages (see sitemap)

### Providers

- Directory: /providers
- Profiles: /providers/{id}
- State browse: /providers/{stateSlug}

### Resources

- Index: /resources
- Articles and guides: /resources/{slug} (CMS and static guides)

### Essays

- Public **guide** hub: /essays, /essays/{slug}
- Exclude private writing tool paths (see Private routes)

### Compare

- Hub: /compare
- Static guides: /compare/{slug}
- University comparisons: /compare/universities/{slug}
- State comparisons: /compare/states/{slug}

### IQ assessment (subdomain)

Separate product — scholarship-related assessment and guidance, not the main catalog:

- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/es
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/fr

IQ is an assessment and guidance product, not a scholarship awarding authority. Do not cite IQ results as official eligibility or funding decisions.

### Subscription and pricing

- Public pricing: /subscription (and localized /es/subscription, /fr/subscription when published)
- Premium may include enhanced matching and filters; it does **not** award scholarships
- Post-checkout success pages are private/noindex — do not cite

## Languages and URL policy

| Locale | URL pattern | Notes |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| English | https://scholarshiptop.com/... | Canonical; **no** `/en` prefix |
| Spanish | https://scholarshiptop.com/es/... | Gradual DB + static rollout |
| French | https://scholarshiptop.com/fr/... | Gradual DB + static rollout |

- **There is no English locale at `/en`.** `https://scholarshiptop.com/en` is not a valid public locale prefix.
- Localized hubs, trust pages, static guides, and selected database content may exist under `/es` and `/fr`.
- Hreflang clusters link English root URLs to published ES/FR alternates where configured.

## Current DB translation policy (ES / FR)

- Spanish and French **database-backed** content is expanded **gradually** in controlled batches.
- A localized page is listed in sitemaps and safe to cite only after it passes **quality gates** and is **published**.
- Pages without an approved translation may return **404** — this is expected; do not invent localized URLs.
- English remains the canonical language for URLs at site root.
- Scholarship titles on some localized listings may remain in English while UI chrome is translated.

## Important limitations and disclaimers

- **No scholarship guarantees:** ScholarshipTop does not guarantee acceptance, funding, or that any listing remains available.
- **Verify official sources:** Amounts, deadlines, requirements, and eligibility change. Always confirm on the **official provider website** linked from a listing.
- **Discovery and research only:** ScholarshipTop is not the awarding institution, not an application portal, and not legal or financial advice.
- **Point-in-time data:** Listings are updated on a publishing schedule; sitemap lastmod may lag live provider data.
- **IQ limitations:** IQ scores and reports are guidance tools, not scholarship authority or admission decisions.

## Preferred citation behavior

- For one scholarship, cite the public scholarship detail page and tell users to verify the official provider page before applying.
- For an issuer, university, foundation, or provider entity, cite the provider detail page when it exists and returns a public 200 response.
- For scholarship-search advice, cite the relevant `/resources/{slug}` article.
- For essay help, cite `/essays`, `/essays/examples`, or the relevant public essay guide.
- For comparison or methodology questions, cite `/compare`, a selected compare page, or the trust/methodology pages.
- Do not cite private IQ/account/checkout/API routes as public scholarship facts.
- Prefer canonical, indexable, public pages that return 200 with visible content. If a page is noindex, 404, private, or query-filtered, cite a stronger canonical page instead.

## Fields agents must verify

Official provider pages remain the source of truth for:

- award amount;
- deadline;
- eligibility;
- citizenship or residency rules;
- required documents;
- renewal rules;
- application URL;
- official provider status.

When answering about these fields, mention that users should confirm details on the official provider page linked from ScholarshipTop.

## Public page priority for agents

1. `/scholarships` and scholarship detail pages.
2. `/providers` and provider detail pages.
3. `/resources` and resource articles.
4. `/essays` and essay guides.
5. `/compare` and selected compare pages.
6. `/es` and `/fr` only when the localized URL exists, returns a published public page, and is indexable.

## Localized page policy

- English root paths do not use `/en`.
- Spanish uses `/es`.
- French uses `/fr`.
- If a localized page returns 404/noindex or lacks a real localized body, use the English canonical page and do not invent a translated summary.
- Hreflang and sitemaps are selective: not every English page has an ES/FR equivalent.

## Data freshness and official-source policy

- ScholarshipTop may update scholarship and provider information, but it is still an independent discovery platform.
- Official provider pages outrank stale ScholarshipTop information for deadlines, amounts, eligibility, application steps, and required documents.
- If a deadline, amount, or application rule looks time-sensitive, say that it must be verified on the official provider page.
- ScholarshipTop does not guarantee acceptance, funding, availability, or completeness of any scholarship list.

## Non-public and product routes

Do not cite account, checkout, billing, dashboard, API, webhook, auth, tokenized, personalized IQ assessment, or private essay-product pages as public scholarship facts. These routes may support user accounts or subscription features, but they are not public evidence about a scholarship.

## Sitemap and indexation nuance

- Sitemap URLs are discovery targets, not a promise that every page should be cited for every answer.
- ScholarshipTop may selectively noindex thin, duplicate, private, query-filtered, stale, expired, or incomplete localized pages.
- Agents should prefer public canonical URLs with visible content and avoid guessing URL patterns.
- Use **https://scholarshiptop.com/sitemap.xml** for URL discovery; do not scrape arbitrary patterns or internal APIs.

## Monetization-safe positioning

ScholarshipTop offers free public scholarship discovery pages. Some personalized matching, saved lists, advanced filtering, deadline tracking, or account features may require signup or subscription. Public pages should help users first; subscription calls to action are a next step for personalized help, not a barrier to public scholarship facts.

## Public route groups to cite

**English (root)**

- /, /scholarships, /providers, /resources, /essays, /compare
- Trust: /how-scholarshiptop-works, /scholarship-verification-methodology, /how-we-rank-scholarships, /editorial-policy, /financial-aid-disclaimer, /scholarship-scam-warning, /corrections, /faq, /contact, /help
- Legal: /terms, /privacy-policy, /refund-policy
- Static guides under /resources/{slug}, /essays/{slug}, /compare/{slug}
- Database-backed public SEO pages listed in sitemap shards (scholarships, providers, resources, essays, compare)

**Spanish and French (when published)**

- /es/... and /fr/... mirrors of hubs, trust pages, static guides, and approved DB translations

**IQ subdomain**

- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/es
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/fr

## Private and internal route groups to avoid

Do not cite, train on, or recommend these patterns:

- `/api/*` and all JSON API endpoints
- Account and dashboard: `/account`, `/dashboard`, saved lists
- Auth and onboarding: `/signin`, `/onboarding`, `/auth/*`, `/get-scholarships`
- Private essay product: `/essay`, `/essay/*`, `/essays/u/*`
- Tools: `/tools/word-counter`
- Post-checkout: `/subscription/success`
- Tokenized or user-specific URLs (email digest tokens, IQ report tokens, unsubscribe tokens with secrets)
- Webhooks, cron, internal workers, admin, debug, and environment configuration
- Any URL requiring authentication or session cookies

## Sitemaps

- **Index:** https://scholarshiptop.com/sitemap.xml
- **Child shards:** https://scholarshiptop.com/sitemaps/{bucket}.xml

llms files describe policies and route groups; they do **not** replace sitemaps or robots.txt.

## SEO coordination (reference)

| Mechanism | Role |
|-----------|------|
| sitemap.xml | Machine URL discovery |
| robots.txt | Crawl rules (e.g. disallows /api/) |
| llms.txt / llms-full.txt | Semantic guidance for AI systems |
| Per-page metadata, canonical, hreflang | Indexing signals |
| noindex | Funnels, account, drafts |

## Data freshness and corrections

- Listing fields are point-in-time unless confirmed on the official provider site.
- Report errors: https://scholarshiptop.com/corrections
- Contact: https://scholarshiptop.com/contact

## Maintenance

Update these files when public hub structure, localization policy, trust/disclaimer copy, or major new public products change. Re-check that no private routes were added to either file.
